record.name: Funded triggered pool order
record.summary: Execute one finite prefunded swap after a real post-swap trigger, with strict amount and price bounds.

units.amounts: Explicit per-field raw currency units; no currency/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual v4 liquidity L, not token balances or dollar depth
units.time: Fields distinguish absolute UTC seconds, durations, block counts and Monday UTC weekly offsets
units.identity: Callback sender is usually a router; signatures/NFTs do not imply human diversity

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code and exact-transfer semantics; no tax/rebase token, decimals or backing inferred.

Recheck against the construction block timestamp; a saved UTC schedule may expire before deployment.
Must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero address validation alone is insufficient.
Beneficiary cannot equal the manager or predicted hook. Funding is an irrevocable gift to this fixed beneficiary’s order.

definition.help: Trigger is pool-local price, not an external oracle. A one-shot partial fill must preserve ceil(minimumOutput × actualInput / inputAmount); remaining input is refunded to the beneficiary, not resubmitted. Fixed-gas nested attempt may fail without undoing the triggering trade; successful execution adds price impact after that fill. Beneficiary may cancel; no keeper or execution guarantee.
